decisions: Current homepage has only same-page internal links; all discovered links, text, images, and metadata are inventoried.
NYU Class of 2028 and Cyera Data Security Intern are verified by public author LinkedIn posts; no internship dates inferred.
LinkedIn profile could not be fetched publicly; no login bypass attempted. Public indexed posts provide precise claims.
Substack feed discovered through an indexed public LinkedIn discussion; five complete RSS bodies cached.
GitHub contribution heatmap and four pinned repos extracted from actual public markup; counts never generated.
ARINZE.OS, Obi/OpenClaw Portal, Garmin dashboard lack identified public source artifacts; do not invent detail pages.
LinkedIn+ public artifact is a bookmarklet, not a verified published Chrome extension.
Yale Innovation Summit appearance, ColorStack, named scholarships, hobbies, and language proficiency not independently verified in this round; omit.
Splita fundraising and internal metrics omitted even where old site mentions them.
GitHub READMEs may describe planned or unverified behavior; retain their limitations and avoid invented impact metrics or personal lessons.
LinkedIn refresh uses checked-in curated posts every six hours because no authorized public feed exists. GitHub and Substack use server-only cached fetch and checked-in last-good fallbacks.
LinkedIn publication dates verified from SocialMediaPosting structured data. Official embed URNs extracted from public post HTML and checked with the official endpoint; no ID guessing.
